# auditrec — audit-store record extractor

Extracts and verifies sealed records from a packed audit-store (`.dat`) archive.

## Usage

```
./auditrec <audit-store.dat> <access-key>
```

Records are chunk-scattered and keyed; without the correct access key the store reads as noise.
